api.notes: Upstream is controlled-only (`value` + onChange). The `value` attribute is the default that reset restores; the property is the current choice. Empty means nothing chosen.
The native `input` then `change` fire once each when the user chooses another option, from the host (composed). Neither fires when `value` is written.
A constraint (valueMissing while nothing is chosen) and `aria-required` on the group.
Object `{type, message}`, or the `status-type` and `status-message` attributes. Always shown detached.

api.reason: Attributes on the host reach the DOM as they are; no prop is needed.

hooks.notes: Family-private context: value, size, disabled, hasDisabledMessage, readonly and select().
A form layout that says "required by default" is announced (aria-required) without blocking the form.

keyboard.action: One tab stop: the chosen option, or the first enabled one when nothing is chosen
Moves focus to the next enabled option and chooses it, wrapping (Left and Right mirror in right-to-left text)
Moves focus to the previous enabled option and chooses it, wrapping

form.notes: Form-associated on the group (ElementInternals): submits `name=value` of the chosen option (nothing while none is chosen), resets to the `value` attribute, restores, joins <fieldset disabled>, works with form= and label for. `required` blocks the submit while nothing is chosen and the blocked submit focuses the first enabled option (the validation anchor); the error is shown after a change, a blur after an edit or a submit attempt.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default (D-006): `value` is a property with the `value` attribute as its default, and native `input`/`change` events report user choices, instead of a controlled `value` plus onChange. Set `value` from the `change` handler to control it.

Radios are `role="radio"` elements inside each option's shadow root, not native inputs: a native radio group cannot span shadow roots. Roving tabindex (one tab stop, arrow keys choose, Left and Right mirror in RTL) replaces the platform's grouping; Home and End do nothing, as for native radios.

Entering an unselected group from the end (Shift+Tab) lands on the first enabled option, not the last: a single tab stop cannot know the direction of entry. The chosen option is always the tab stop when there is one.

The radio (the focusable element) is inside the option, so links and buttons in the label, `start` or `end` content stay in the tab order; the host never takes `tabindex`. `aria-readonly` is on the group only (it is not allowed on a radio).
Validation is displayed after user interaction: the browser's message becomes the detached status, `aria-invalid` on the group and `:state(user-invalid)` flip together and are announced once.
`name` is optional and only names the form entry: grouping does not depend on it (upstream generates one for native radio grouping).

core.radio-list.notes: Guides: [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements] a FACE on the group with a validation anchor (earlier-project review H6); [mwg:accessible-web-components] the radiogroup, its label and description share one shadow root; [mwg:required-field-feedback] and [mwg:validate-input-after-interaction]; [mwg:accessible-error-announcement].

api.notes: A host aria-label names the radio.

hooks.reason: The ring is drawn on the radio element with the shared focus-ring module, which is the indicator's own shape.

keyboard.action: Chooses the option (the list owns the keys)

form.notes: The list is the form participant and submits the chosen option's value.

differences.text: `label`, `description`, `start` and `end` are attributes and slots: a rich label or description is `slot="label"` / `slot="description"`. The radio is named by the label element through `aria-labelledby` inside the option's shadow root, and described by the description; a host `aria-label` replaces the label.

The row is bare: no padding, corners, fill or hover wash; only the radio (the shared radio indicator: an empty ring, a dot when chosen, no accent) tints on hover and shows the pressed overlay. The ring is 2px hot pink on the radio.

requests.reason: Same as CheckboxInput: rendering the registry-resolved indicator tag (defineIndicators) needs a core helper using unsafeStatic. Until then the default `tct-radio-indicator` is rendered.
